title: 670. 2 Keys Keyboard

examples.explanation: The single A is already there.
Copy, paste to 2, copy, paste to 4, paste to 6.

hints: A paste run from size a to a multiple m*a costs one copy plus (m - 1) pastes, i.e. m steps for the factor m.
Hence the optimum equals the sum of the prime factors of n with multiplicity.
Peel off the smallest divisor repeatedly; whatever prime remains counts itself.
